title: Case Against Huang Ih Ling Alias Lau Li Alias Lao Pa Ts Charged With Propagating Communism

page_data.en:
D. 5651.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5651
Date 7 / 2 / 34

CCP
February 6, 34.

Dear Mr. Sarly,

I forward herewith for your information tabulated
statement relating to the arrest by the Municipal Police
of a communist named Huang Ih Ling (黄以林) alias Lau
Li (老李) alias Lao Pa Ts (老巴子) at 10.30 p.m.
January 26, 1934 at No.48 Tong Hsung Lee off Point Road.

The accused appeared on remand before the Second
Branch of the Kiangsu High Court on January 31, 1934 and
was ordered to be handed over to the Chinese authorities.

Yours sincerely,

Monsieur R. Sarly,
Chief of the Political Section,
French Police Headquarters.

Huang Ih Ling(黄以林) alias Lau Pah Ts(老疤子)
Anhwei
D.S.I. Prokofiev
S.2, H'dars
Jan. 29, 1934,
Clerk Fang Kuo Liang

My name is Huang Ih Ling alias Lau Pa Ts, age 28,
native of Nan Ling(南陵) Hsien, Anhwei. At the age of 7,
I attended a private school in my native village for about
half a year, after which I worked as a farmer. I remained
in my home working on the farm until I was 24 years of age
when I left for Wuhu where I was employed as coolie on the
Taiku Wharf. I left this employment on December 29, 1933
when I departed for Shanghai, arriving here on January 1,
1934. On the night of January 1 and January 2, I slept in
the market in Hart Road, and put up at the present place of
abode - kitchen room of No.48 Dong Sung Li(同生里), Point and
East Seward Roads - since January 3.

The small slips of paper seized by the Police from the
person of my sweetheart Van Zau Sz(范趙氏) were brought to
me by my cousin named Zao King Sung(曹明生), who is a cloth
dealer travelling between Wuhu and Shanghai. As I had asked
him to lend me some money, Zao one day came to my home and,
as I was absent at that time, he wrote these slips of paper
to show that he had already lent his money to other people
and that he had no money for me.

I am not a communist and I did not participate in any
political activities.

I can write and read Chinese a little.

(Signed & cross-marked) Huang Ih Ling.

D.S.I. Prokofiev
S.2, H'dars
1934年1月29日，
职员 方国良（Fang Kuo Liang）

我叫黄以林，别名老巴子，28岁，籍贯安徽南陵（Nan Ling）县。7岁时，我在本村私塾读了约半年书，之后务农。我一直在家种地，直到24岁离开家乡前往芜湖，在太古码头做苦力。我于1933年12月29日辞去该工作，前往上海，于1934年1月1日抵达此地。1月1日和1月2日晚，我睡在赫德路（Hart Road）的市场里，自1月3日起住在目前的住所——百老汇路（Point Road）和东熙华德路（East Seward Roads）旁同生里（Dong Sung Li）48号的厨房房间。

警方从我情人范赵氏（Van Zau Sz）身上搜获的小纸片，是由我的表弟曹明生（Zao King Sung）带给我的，他是一名往返于芜湖和上海之间的布商。因为我曾向他借钱，有一天曹来到我家，当时我不在，他便写下这些纸片，表明他已将钱借给他人，无钱借给我。

我不是共产党员，也没有参与任何政治活动。

我能读写一点中文。

（签名并画十字标记）黄以林。

诉讼过程。 T.Y. Chang 先生代表警方出庭。

At about 10-20.p.m. 26-1-34 D. S. I. Prokofiev and D. S. 48 of the Special Branch, and Det-Sub-Inspector Chang Shao Ou. ( 張筱安 ) of the Public Safety Bureau came to the station with a Warrant of Arrest. (No.1195) issued by the 1st. Special District Court on the 26-1-34 for the arrest of a man known as Lau Li. ( 老李 ) residing at No.48 Tong Hsung Lee, off Point Road for suspected Communism.

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
being questioned the accused male stated that he had come to Shanghai from his native Wuhu, arriving in Sganghai on the 1-1-34. He came to Shanghai in order to look for employment.

He had formerly known the female in Wuhu and on arriving here, went to an employment agency on the Connaught Road where he met the female, and subsequently they both went to the address on the Point Road, where they hired a room for $7-50cts. per month, in order to live together.

Accused denies being connected with Communists.

The female tells a story somewhat similar to that of the male, and further states that the slips of paper found in her possession had been brought to the house on the night of the 25-1-34 by a man known as Tsao.( 曹 ) who instructed her to give them to the male.

A statement has been taken from the male who will appear before the Court on the 27-1-34 when a short remand will be asked that certain formalities may be complied with.

The P. S. Bureau do not want the female and as nothing incriminating was found proving her guilt, she was subsequently released.

经讯问，该男被告称其从家乡芜湖来到上海，于1934年1月1日抵达上海。他来上海是为了寻找工作。

他此前在芜湖便认识该女子，抵达上海后，前往康纳路（Connaught Road）的一家职业介绍所，在那里与该女子相遇，随后两人一同前往溧阳路（Point Road）的某址，以每月7.50美元的租金租下一间房间，以便同居。

被告否认与共产党有关联。

该女子的陈述与男子的说法大致相似，并进一步说明，在她身上发现的纸条是由一名叫曹（Tsao）的男子于1934年1月25日晚带到家中的，该男子指示她将这些纸条交给该男子。

已对该男子取得供词，他将于1934年1月27日出庭，届时将申请短期还押，以便履行某些法定手续。

政治部不需要该女子，且未发现任何能证明其有罪的确凿证据，故随后将其释放。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Huang Ih Ling alias Lao Pa Ts 黄以林即老把子
native of Wuhu taken by me
at Hongkew on the 26/1/34 and translated inspected by Clerk Ling

I am twenty-eight years of age. Formerly I worked as a
coolie at Wong Nyi Factory (near China Steam Navigation Co.)
of Wuhu.
I left Wuhu and came to Shanghai on the 1-1-34
On 29/12/33, ~~I came to Shanghai from Wuhu~~, to look for work.
I went to visit my sweetheart named Wan Chaio Sz (萬趙氏) at
~~employment bureau of~~ Connaught Road. ( I knew her when she was
in ~~the~~ country and also I knew her address in Shanghai because I
saw her letters mailed to ~~the~~ country). Then I consulted with her
if she would con-habituate with ~~him~~ me. She immediately agreed
to do so and I rent a kitchen upstairs room at 48 Dong Sung Li,
off E. Seward Rd. One week ago, my cousin Zao Ming Sung(曹明生)
together with one named Tsao (趙 ), came to my house and they
gossiped with me for a while. At 6 p.m. yesterday (25/1/34)
Zao Ming Sung came to see me again, giving 4 or 5 slips of
accounts' papers to my sweetheart when I was absent. When I
came back home, she produced those papers, which, after I had
investigated, were given back to her to keep on her body.
At 10.30 p.m. 26/1/34 I was located by the Police. I knew
nothing about the Communism. This is true statement.

(Sgd.) Huang Ih Ling.

警方调查报告。

以下为黄以林（别名老把子），芜湖籍人，于1934年1月26日在虹口由我录取、经凌书记员翻译并审阅的供词：

我今年二十八岁。以前我在芜湖的黄义工厂（近中国轮船公司）做苦力。
我离开芜湖，于1934年1月1日来到上海
1933年12月29日，~~我从芜湖来到上海~~，为了找工作。
我去康纳路（Connaught Road）的职业介绍所看望我的情人万赵氏（Wan Chaio Sz）。（我在乡下时就认识她，我也知道她在上海的地址，因为我见过寄往乡下的她的信件）。然后我与她商量是否愿意与我同居。她立即同意，于是我在东熙华德路（E. Seward Rd.）旁的东宋里48号租了一间楼上的灶披间。一周前，我的表兄曹明生（Zao Ming Sung）和一名姓赵（Tsao）的人来到我家，与我闲聊了一会儿。昨天（1934年1月25日）下午6点，曹明生又来看我，趁我不在时，给了我情人4或5张账条纸。我回家后，她拿出那些纸条，我查看后，让她收在身上保存。
1934年1月26日晚上10点30分，我被警察找到。我对共产主义一无所知。此乃真实供词。

（签名）黄以林。
